sourceTitle: Notes of an Overland Journey Through France and Egypt to Bombay
description: "Notes of an Overland Journey Through France and Egypt to Bombay" by Emma Roberts is a travel narrative written in the early 19th century. This account depicts the author's adventurous journey as she travels from London to Bombay, offering vivid descriptions of her experiences in France, Egypt, and eventually India.
